name: Grand Ole Bbq Y Asado
notes: First-party source: the restaurant's own Toast online-ordering page for the North Park store (toasttab.com/local/order/gobnp, which redirects to toast.app/r/gobnp/order and grandolebbq.toast.site/order/gobnp). Address confirmed as 3302 32nd St, San Diego, which is North Park and matches the stored location. Pickup menu, so no delivery markup; no price divides evenly by 1.10 or 1.15 into a round number. BBQ meats are sold by weight - the section header reads 'Meat priced by weight (per pound). We recommend a 1/2 pound of meat per adult as a meal size.' The menu grid only shows the 1/4-pound base price with a '+' (e.g. Brisket $8.75+), so the per-pound figure was read from each item's own size-option list. Verified on two items that the tiers scale linearly: Brisket 1/4 lb $8.75, 1/2 lb $17.50, 3/4 lb $26.25, 1 lb $35.00; Pulled Pork 1/4 lb $7.50, 1/2 lb $15.00, 3/4 lb $22.50, 1 lb $30.00. Per-pound prices are recorded for the by-weight meats and the description states so. The two sausage links (Texas Hot Link, Jalapeno Cheddar Link) have no size selector and are flat per-link prices. Sides and chilis also carry a '+' for larger pint/quart portions; the published base (smallest) size price is recorded. Many items were flagged OUT OF STOCK at the time of extraction, which is a live inventory state rather than a menu removal, so they are kept with their listed prices and noted in the dish description. A widely cited AAA review quotes meats at $14-25 per pound; that tier is stale and was rejected in favor of the live first-party $30-36 per pound. White Bread is listed with no price and was omitted. The Kids section (3 items) was dropped to stay within the 45-dish cap. Drinks and alcohol omitted.

name: Yesenia's Mexican Food
notes: This taco shop has no first-party website and no Toast/Square/Clover/ChowNow ordering page - the Yelp business page carries no external ordering link at all, so no first-party source exists. Prices were read directly off a photograph of the restaurant's own in-store menu boards, Yelp photo id -7bWZPKUSK-BZyiQbqhQfw, taken 5/3/26 and uploaded 5/5/26, i.e. about three months before extraction. That makes it a photo of the restaurant's own posted price board rather than an aggregator's copy, which is why confidence is medium rather than low despite being sourced from Yelp. The original is only 1000x563 px, so every value here was re-read at 3-6x magnification on cropped regions rather than from the full-frame view; a first low-zoom pass misread the lead taco price as 5.39 when it is 5.99, so the burrito and taco columns were both re-verified at high zoom and the name-to-price row alignment was counted item by item (23 burrito names to 23 burrito prices, 11 taco names to 11 taco prices). STALENESS: the inherited warning that a previously found Yesenia's listing was roughly a decade out of date is confirmed and that tier is rejected - the current board has meat burritos at 12.99-13.49 and street tacos at 5.75-5.99, not the sub-8-dollar tier. The single item that reads under 8 dollars, the Bean & Cheese burrito at 7.99, is not a stale price: it is the plain meatless burrito sitting in the same column as the 12.99 meat burritos, and that spread is internally consistent. No delivery markup is present - this is an in-store board, and the prices do not divide evenly by 1.10 or 1.15 (12.99/1.15 = 11.30, 5.75/1.10 = 5.23). CROSS-CHECK: a second, independent Yelp photo (id ryeKwN2ErARDw7vVaal39w) of the same restaurant's other menu boards, showing the Yesenia's logo, reproduces the overlapping Soups and Cocktails lines exactly as recorded here - Shrimp & Fish, Shrimp and Fish soups all 18.99, Shrimp Cocktail 17.99, Ceviche Tostada 8.99, 2 Ceviche Tostadas 14.99 - so the two photos are from the same price era and the readings agree. That board also shows tortas at 12.99-13.99, matching the 12.99 burrito tier, which is a further consistency check. Two other text sources were tried and rejected: zmenu.com carries only menu images and no prices, and the Uber Eats listing for 'Yesenia's mexican & sea food' is a DIFFERENT restaurant at 8199 Clairemont Mesa Blvd, San Diego 92111, on a visibly older price tier (chicken salad 8.95) - that Clairemont listing is most likely the decade-stale source flagged in the handoff, and none of its prices were used. ADDRESS FLAG: Yelp lists this location as 12075 Carmel Mountain Rd, San Diego, CA 92128. That is the Carmel Mountain Ranch neighborhood, not Rancho Bernardo proper, though it sits in the 92128 Rancho Bernardo ZIP and is about two miles from Rancho Bernardo center. Extracted anyway; flagging the discrepancy. Note there is a separate and unrelated 'Yesenia's Mexican Food & Ice Cream' at 2505 El Cajon Blvd in City Heights - its Grubhub and Yelp listings were NOT used, as that is a different restaurant. Cut for the 45-dish cap: the Tortas, Quesadillas, Enchiladas and combination-plate boards (plates run about 14.25-14.99), the seafood plates (Shrimp Ranchero, Shrimp Fajitas and Mar Y Tierra at 17.99, Breaded Shrimp at 18.99), and the remaining soups (Shrimp, Fish and 7 Mares, all 18.99, same as the Shrimp & Fish soup listed here). 'Wet Style' at 4.49 appears in the burrito column but is an add-on upcharge, not a dish, so it was omitted. '2 Ceviche Tostadas' at 14.99 was also cut for the cap as redundant with the single Ceviche Tostada at 8.99. The board lists no descriptions for individual items, so descriptions are empty except where the board itself printed one.
